description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Horethuduwa, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530011
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including ownership details, property extents, encumbrances, and legal status of various land plots in Horethuduwa. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including land registrations, property ownership, and land titles as specified in Type 4 classification.
